claims.statement: On the last night of his benefit at the Theater Comique, September 26, 1873, Tom Allen was to have a set-to with Jack Madden, with Patsey Sheppard and Arthur Chambers also boxing.
claims.excerpt: lien and Madden will have-a set-to,ad will Patsey

notes: Printed as 'lien' for Allen. The rest of the page is theatre listings.
